_comment: Run-scoped boons. Same modifier/hook schema as rulesets. None of them may reduce the amount of real work a node asks for — they move rewards and information only.

trinkets.name: Second Breath
trinkets.desc: Scaling a movement down costs you nothing — full Grit either way.

trinkets.name: Wanderer's Charm
trinkets.desc: One extra side node rolls in every area.

trinkets.name: Clear Eyes
trinkets.desc: Every side node is visible from the moment you enter.

trinkets.name: Steady Hand
trinkets.desc: +4 Grit every time you finish a task.

trinkets.name: Open Road
trinkets.desc: Six extra hours on every deadline.

trinkets.name: Kind Word
trinkets.desc: Spite's gentler half turns up twice as often.

trinkets.name: First of Many
trinkets.desc: +50 Grit when you clear an area.

trinkets.name: Banked Fire
trinkets.desc: Grit converts to Resolve 40% better at the end of the run.
